title: Never replay a transaction journal SpecSync did not write, or into Git's files
description: Never replay a transaction journal SpecSync did not write, or into Git's files
acceptance_criteria: A journal at .specsync/change-transaction.json that Git tracks, in the index or in HEAD, is never replayed: the writing change command refuses and names the git rm fix. A journal entry with a .git component in any letter case, or with trailing dots or spaces, or naming a file outside .specsync/, the configured specs_dir and the registry-mapped spec files with their requirements.md and history fragments, refuses the whole journal and replays nothing. A bare-array journal is refused with the invalid-journal recovery. The person's own interrupted write is still recovered. The new tests fail on cf528407 and pass with the fix

answers.constraints: change.3md: a refusal is a result worth recording and names its recovery (#433, #847); the existing invalid-journal message and its .broken recovery are reused. util.3md lesson: stay inside the root by construction, and enforce the same rule where a path is written and where it is replayed.
